question: A can lay railway track between two given stations in 19 days and B can do the same job in 11 days. With the help of C, they did the job in 3 days only. Then, C alone can do the job in
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__
**Total Work** (LCM of 19, 11, 3) = 627 units.

**Efficiency** of **A** = 627 ÷ 19 = 33; **B** = 627 ÷ 11 = 57; **A+B+C** = 627 ÷ 3 = 209.

**Efficiency** of **C** = 209 − (33 + 57) = 119.

**Time** taken by **C** = 627 ÷ 119 = 5(32/119) days.

**∴ The correct answer is 5(32/119) days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Time taken by **A** = 19 days, **B** = 11 days, and **A + B + C** = 3 days.

**Formula Used:** 1/Tₜₒₜₐₗ = 1/TA + 1/TB + 1/TC

 **Person** **Days** **Total Work** **Efficiency**
 **A** 19 627 33
 **B** 11 57
 **A + B + C** 3 209
⇒ Efficiency of **C** = (Efficiency of **A+B+C**) − (Efficiency of **A** + Efficiency of **B**)

⇒ Efficiency of **C** = 209 − (33 + 57)

⇒ Efficiency of **C** = 209 − 90 = 119

⇒ Time taken by **C** = Total Work ÷ Efficiency of **C**

⇒ Time = 627 ÷ 119 = 5(32/119) days

**∴ The correct answer is 5(32/119) days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Work and Efficiency Relationship

Efficiency is inversely proportional to the time taken to complete a work. If a person completes a work in 'n' days, their one-day work (efficiency) is 1/n.

Combined Work Formula

When multiple people work together, their individual efficiencies are added to find the combined efficiency: 1/Tₜₒgₑₜₕₑᵣ = Σ(1/Tᵢₙdᵢvᵢdᵤₐₗ).</p
